products.name: DSPy
products.note: Declarative prompt-and-weight optimization; compile pipelines against a metric instead of hand-tuning prompts; Stanford NLP research lineage

profile_text.body:
Stanford NLP is a university research lab, not a for-profit company, operating out of Stanford University. The website on record resolves to GitHub rather than a dedicated lab site, so direct information from the lab's own web presence is limited in this data.

The lab is tracked for one product, DSPy, an open-source framework hosted at github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy. DSPy is described as a declarative system for prompt and weight optimization that allows developers to compile language model pipelines against a defined metric rather than tuning prompts by hand, and it carries a Stanford NLP research lineage.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for this entity.
